name: Conic Spinner
description: A circular spinner that fills like a pie chart, revealing color clockwise in 8 stepped increments

variations.name: default
variations.description: Circular pie-style loader that fills clockwise from 0° to 360° in 8 equal steps over 2 seconds

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
